It’s limited to a select number of LLMs. Given how rapidly the LLM landscape and market share are changing, it would benefit from broader visibility across the core LLMs, along with clearer insight into how they differ by model and at the country level.

One area where Profound could improve is the depth of customization available in certain reports and dashboards. While the platform provides valuable insights out of the box, there are times when I'd like more flexibility in how data is segmented and visualized for different stakeholders.

That said, these are relatively minor concerns, and the platform continues to provide significant value for understanding and improving brand visibility across AI-powered search experiences.
